title: Layered cardboard rhino
description: An original stylised standing rhinoceros about 300 mm long, laser-cut from white-faced corrugated board: straight-walled layers of its sections, stacked parallel to its plane of symmetry, each layer but the middle pair placed on its neighbour's engraved outline.
